cards.front: First trimester screening (FTS) thuc hien o tuan thai nao? CRL? 3 muc tieu chinh?
cards.back:
FTS o 11+0 den 13+6 tuan (CRL 45-84 mm).

3 muc tieu chinh (theo ISUOG 2022 PMID 36594739):
1. Xac dinh tuoi thai chinh xac (CRL).
2. Sang loc bat thuong NST (T21, T18, T13) - Combined test hoac NIPT.
3. Danh gia giai phau thai som (early anatomy) - phat hien ~50% di tat lon.

cards.front: 3 lua chon chinh trong sang loc bat thuong NST quy 1?
cards.back:
1. Combined test (NT + PAPP-A + free beta-hCG): detect ~90% T21, FPR 5%.
2. NIPT (cfDNA): sens >99% T21, FPR <0.1% (Zhang 2015, n=146,958 PMID 25598039).
3. Contingent screening: Combined truoc, NIPT cho nhom intermediate risk (1:100-1:1000) - tiet kiem chi phi.

cards.front: Ky thuat do Nuchal Translucency (NT) theo FMF?
cards.back:
Yeu cau ky thuat (Fetal Medicine Foundation):

- Tuoi thai: 11+0 den 13+6 tuan (CRL 45-84 mm).
- Mat cat: Sagittal (dung doc giua thai).
- Hinh anh: Thai chiem 75% man hinh, mat va nguc song song voi probe.
- Vi tri do: Vung day nhat cua khoang duoi da sau co.
- Calipers: ON-ON (dat tren duong trang-trong cua da, khong de vao).
- Phan biet: Da (membranous) khac amnion (o tuoi thai nay chua dinh).
- So lan do: >= 3 lan, lay gia tri lon nhat.

cards.front: Dien gia NT theo do day?
cards.back:
Theo FMF:

- < 3.0 mm (hoac < p95 theo CRL): Binh thuong - tiep tuc routine.
- 3.0-3.4 mm: Borderline - Combined test chi tiet + NIPT can nhac.
- >= 3.5 mm: Day - Combined test + NIPT + CVS/amniocentesis tu van.
- >= 6.0 mm: Rat day - nguy co cao aneuploidy + cardiac defect, can diagnostic test + fetal echo 18-22 tuan.

cards.front: NT day co nhung nguy co gi (khong chi aneuploidy)?
cards.back:
NT day KHONG chi aneuploidy - con lien quan:

1. Cardiac defect: 5-10% thai co NT >= p99 co CHD (ngay ca khi karyotype binh thuong).
2. Genetic syndromes: Noonan, Smith-Lemli-Opitz, etc.
3. Fetal anemia: Parvovirus B19, alloimmunization.
4. NT day + binh thuong karyotype: tang nguy co can theo doi tim mach o 20-22 tuan.

=> NT day = can danh gia nhieu kha nang, khong phai ket luan aneuploidy ngay.

cards.front: Co so sinh hoc: PAPP-A va free beta-hCG trong T21/T18/T13?
cards.back:
Pattern dac trung:

- T21: PAPP-A GIAM (low MoM) + free beta-hCG TANG (high MoM).
- T18: PAPP-A GIAM MANH + free beta-hCG GIAM.
- T13: PAPP-A GIAM + free beta-hCG GIAM.

PAPP-A: glycoprotein do nhau tiet, tang dan theo tuoi thai.
Free beta-hCG: tiet tu hop bao nuoi (syncytiotrophoblast).

=> Pattern khac nhau giua T21 va T18/T13 giup phan biet som.

cards.front: Cong thuc tinh risk cho Combined test?
cards.back:
Risk = Base risk (theo tuoi me) x Likelihood ratio (LR)
      = Base risk x LR(NT) x LR(PAPP-A) x LR(free beta-hCG)

Vi du: Me 35 tuoi (base risk T21 = 1:350)
- NT 2.5 mm (binh thuong) -> LR ~0.5
- PAPP-A 0.8 MoM (binh thuong) -> LR ~0.7
- Free beta-hCG 1.5 MoM (cao nhe) -> LR ~1.5
- Final risk = 1:350 x 0.5 x 0.7 x 1.5 = 1:1111 (giam so voi base risk).

Phan mem: FMF risk calculator, Astraia, ViewPoint.

cards.front: NIPT co che va fetal fraction?
cards.back:
NIPT (Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing) / cfDNA:

- Tu tuan thu 5+, cell-free DNA cua thai (cfDNA) xuat hien trong mau me.
- cfDNA tu apoptosis cua trophoblast (nhau thai).
- Ty le cfDNA thai / tong cfDNA = fetal fraction (thuong 5-15% o 11 tuan).
- Phan tich cfDNA bang massively parallel sequencing hoac SNP-based methods.

NIPT chi sang loc (screening), KHONG chan doan. Positive NIPT can diagnostic test (CVS/amniocentesis) truoc khi quyet dinh thai ky.

cards.front: Hieu qua NIPT theo Zhang H. 2015 (n=146,958)?
cards.back:
Meta-analysis BGI clinical data (PMID 25598039, UOG):

- Tong N = 146,958 pregnancies (low + high risk).
- Sensitivity: T21 99.17%, T18 98.24%, T13 100%.
- Specificity: T21 99.95%, T18 99.95%, T13 99.96%.
- KHONG khac biet giua high-risk (n=72,382) va low-risk (n=40,287) populations.
- PPV (positive predictive value) phu thuoc a priori risk - low-risk co PPV thap hon vi prevalence thap.

cards.front: 5 han che cua NIPT?
cards.back:
5 han che quan trong:

1. CHI SANG LOC, KHONG CHAN DOAN - positive NIPT CAN diagnostic test (CVS/amniocentesis) truoc khi quyet dinh.
2. Test failure ~2-5%: thai som, fetal fraction thap, maternal obesity.
3. False positive: confined placental mosaicism (CPM), maternal CNV, vanishing twin, maternal malignancy (hiem).
4. False negative: fetal fraction < 4%, mosaicism thap, maternal obesity (BMI > 35).
5. NIPT KHONG phat hien: structural fetal anomalies, NT day, pre-eclampsia screening markers, monochorionic twins co han che.

cards.front: Vi sao NIPT KHONG the thay the sieu am 11-14 tuan?
cards.back:
Theo Suciu 2021 (PMID 31766927) va Bromley 2024 (PMID 38723258):

NIPT chi phan tich cfDNA trong mau me, KHONG cho thong tin ve:

1. Dating chinh xac (CRL-based).
2. NT (Nuchal Translucency) - marker quan trong cho aneuploidy + cardiac defect.
3. Structural fetal anomalies (khoang 50% di tat lon co the phat hien som o 11-14 tuan).
4. Pre-eclampsia screening (PlGF, uterine artery Doppler).
5. Multiple gestations va chorionicity.
6. Nasal bone, tricuspid regurgitation, DV a-wave.

=> NIPT la advanced screening, KHONG thay the sieu am.

cards.front: Contingent screening la gi? Uu diem?
cards.back:
Contingent screening = Combined test truoc, NIPT cho nhom intermediate risk.

Uu diem (theo Suciu 2021 PMID 31766927):

1. Tiet kiem chi phi so voi NIPT cho tat ca (NIPT dat tien hon combined test 5-10 lan).
2. Van duy tri detection rate cao (>95% voi cut-off toi uu).
3. Phu hop voi public health system (NHS UK, Dan Mach, Ha Lan, mot so bang Australia).
4. Cut-off dien hinh: NIPT cho nhom risk 1:100 den 1:1000 (mot so he thong 1:50 den 1:2500).

=> Chien luoc tot cho cac nuoc co nguon luc han che, giam chi phi nhung van bao ve detection rate.

cards.front: First trimester anatomy scan phat hien duoc gi?
cards.back:
Theo ISUOG 2022 (PMID 36594739) va Bromley 2024 (PMID 38723258):

Phat hien ~50% di tat lon o 11-14 tuan.

Cau truc co the danh gia:
- Nao: skull, midline, choroid plexus, ventricles.
- Mat: orbits, nasal bone, profile.
- Tim: 4-chamber view (thuong), outflow tracts (kho hon).
- Bung: stomach, liver, kidneys, bladder.
- Cot song: 3 vung (co, nguc, that lung).
- Tu chi: 3 segments (dui, cang, ban).
- Day ron: 3 vessels.
- Placenta, amniotic fluid.

Bromley 2024: nen offer cho MOI thai phu khong phu thuoc ket qua aneuploidy screening.

cards.front: 5 markers quan trong cho aneuploidy o quy 1?
cards.back:
5 markers (theo FMF):

1. NT day (>= p95): T21, T18, T13, Turner - tang ca 4 nhom.
2. Absent/hypoplastic nasal bone: T21 (+++), T18 (++), T13 (+).
3. Tricuspid regurgitation: T21 (++), T18 (+), T13 (+).
4. Abnormal DV a-wave: T21 (++), T18 (+++), T13 (+), Turner (+++).
5. Aberrant right subclavian artery: T21 (+) - 3VT view.

cards.front: Algorithm sang loc aneuploidy 2024? (5 buoc)
cards.back:
Thai 11-13+6 tuan -> Sieu am 11-14 tuan (ISUOG) -> Danh gia base risk.

Buoc 1: Nguyen co cao (me >= 35, tien su aneuploidy, NT >= 3.5 mm, structural anomaly)?
-> Tu van diagnostic test (CVS/amniocentesis) + NIPT neu khong muon invasive.

Buoc 2: Nguyen co trung binh (me < 35, khong yeu to nguy co)?
-> Combined test HOAC NIPT (neu co dieu kien).

Buoc 3: Nguyen co thap (me tre, binh thuong)?
-> Combined test (NIPT khong khuyen cao vi PPV thap).

Buoc 4: Ket qua Combined:
- High risk (>= 1:150) -> diagnostic test hoac NIPT.
- Intermediate (1:151-1:1000) -> NIPT (Contingent).
- Low risk (< 1:1000) -> Tiep tuc routine, anatomy scan 18-22 tuan.

cards.front: Aneuploidy screening trong twins - khuyen cao?
cards.back:
Theo Hopkins 2023 (PMID 37438894):

- NIPT first-line cho twins (ca MC va DC) theo ACOG/SMFM 2020.
- Neu NIPT khong kha thi: Combined test (NT do ca 2 thai) + serum markers.
- NT cut-off o twins: van dung nguong singleton (chua co consensus rieng).
- Chorionicity phai xac dinh o 11-14 tuan (lambda sign hoac T-sign).
- NIPT o DC twins: sens T21 ~95% (thap hon singleton ~99%), T13 ~80%.
- NIPT o MC twins: tuong duong singleton (vi cung cfDNA).
- Vanishing twin: NIPT co the false positive do cfDNA thai chet.

cards.front: First trimester biomarkers cho Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)?
cards.back:
Mortaki 2024 meta-analysis (PMID 39305990, 8 studies, n=1,886):

- PAPP-A: PAS > previa (MD 0.48 MoM; 95% CI 0.23-0.73, p=0.0001).
- Free beta-hCG: previa > binh thuong (MD 0.27 MoM; 95% CI 0.17-0.38, p<0.00001).

Y nghia: First trimester combined test co the giup sang loc som PAS o thai phu co nguy co (tien su mo lay thai + placenta previa).

Luu y: Can nhac PAS neu thai phu co tien su mo lay thai nhieu lan + placenta previa, dac biet o vung sau (posterior) hoac anterior low-lying.

cards.front: NIPT test failure - xu tri the nao?
cards.back:
NIPT test failure xay ra o ~2-5% thai phu.

Nguyen nhan:
- Thai qua som (< 10 tuan, fetal fraction < 4%).
- Maternal obesity (BMI > 35, fetal fraction bi pha loang).
- Heparin/lovenox therapy (anh huong ky thuat sequencing).
- Maternal malignancy (hien, nhung can luu y).
- Vanishing twin.

Xu tri:
- KHONG lap lai NIPT (ti le that bai tiep theo cao).
- Chuyen sang Combined test neu chua lam.
- Hoac CVS/amniocentesis neu co yeu to nguy co khac.
- Cho thai lon hon (15-16 tuan) roi xet lai NIPT neu can.

cards.front: NIPT mở rộng (beyond common trisomies) - can nhac gi?
cards.back:
Mot so lab cung cap:

- Sex chromosome aneuploidy (Turner 45,X, Klinefelter 47,XXY): nhay hon nhung PPV thap.
- Microdeletion syndromes (22q11.2 = DiGeorge, 1p36, etc.): PPV rat thap.
- Rare autosomal trisomy (RAT).

CAN NHAC KY truoc khi offer extended NIPT:
1. PPV thap (1-5% cho microdeletion) -> nhieu false positive.
2. False positive co the dan den unnecessary invasive procedures.
3. Counseling truoc va sau test rat quan trong.
4. ACMG khuyen cao: chi offer sex chromosome aneuploidy screening khi co clinical concern, KHONG routine.

cards.front: Khi nao CRL > 84 mm thi chuyen sang HC de dating?
cards.back:
Theo ISUOG 2019 (PMID 31169958):

- CRL chinh xac nhat trong dating pregnancy (8-14 tuan).
- Khi CRL > 84 mm (~14 tuan): chuyen sang dung Head Circumference (HC) de dating.
- HC co the dung cho dating tu mid-trimester neu khong co first-trimester scan va menstrual history khong reliable.
- HC + FL co the combine de dating tu mid-trimester.
- Khi da co early scan chinh xac: KHONG dung scan sau de recalculate gestational age.
